name: Grand Hotel River Park
positioning: Grand Hotel River Park, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Bratislava: a riverside hotel on the Danube promenade with a top-floor spa and pool overlooking the river
best_for: Travelers who want a Danube-side base within walking distance of Bratislava's Old Town
Guests who want a spa and indoor pool with river views
Families wanting connecting rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel sits on the Danube river promenade, a 15-minute walk from the historic Old Town.
The riverside promenade gives a direct pedestrian connection to the historic city center and suits a morning jog, a sunset stroll or a bike ride.
ZION SPA Luxury, on the 11th floor, has panoramic Danube views, bespoke treatments, a pool, hot tubs, saunas and a steam room.
The indoor pool on the 11th floor has hydro massage, bubble loungers and a jacuzzi with panoramic views.
Rooms start at 35 square meters and include high-speed wireless internet, a mini-bar and individually controlled air conditioning.
Suites have marble bathrooms with rainfall showers and bathtubs.
The Grand Living Room on the 9th floor is a lounge for relaxing or working.
Connecting rooms and suites are available for families.
The top-floor gym has Danube views.
Both restaurants have outdoor terraces overlooking the Danube.
The hotel was formerly the Kempinski River Park before joining the Luxury Collection in 2015.
The concierge can arrange a private speedboat tour on the Danube.

highlights.text: The Presidential Suite has handwoven Persian carpets and a bathroom with 24-karat gold tiles, onyx and black marble.
Guests can arrive by the hotel's private rooftop heliport or private river pier.
Every suite, from the Junior Suite to the Presidential Suite, has Danube views and access to ZION Spa Luxury.
The Presidential Suite has a 75-square-meter terrace with views of Bratislava and the Danube.
The glass wine cellar at the Lobby Lounge holds more than 300 Slovak and international wines and is the biggest hotel wine cellar in Slovakia.

considerations.text: Reaching the historic Old Town means a 15-minute walk along the Danube river promenade.
The spa area is available at an extra charge.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
